# Architecture

<!-- Generated by /ai-context. Manual edits are overwritten on re-run. -->

## AS IS — Current state

### Style

Nuxt 4 file-based, component-composition SPA/SSR: a single page (`app/pages/index.vue`) composes self-contained section components; no controllers, no services layer, no store observed.

### Directory layout

```
app/                          # Nuxt srcDir
├── app.vue                   # root component
├── error.vue                 # custom error / 404 page
├── assets/css/main.css       # Tailwind entry + global styles
├── components/
│   ├── AppBrandLogo.vue      # brand mark (single-word name, allowed by ESLint override)
│   └── sections/             # one component per landing-page section
│       ├── HeroSection.vue           # typewriter, animated counters, spotlight/particles
│       ├── AboutSection.vue          # career timeline (scroll-triggered)
│       ├── AboutTimelineStep.vue     # single timeline entry
│       ├── StackSection.vue          # tech stack container
│       ├── StackTechGroup.vue        # group (frontend/backend/data/infra)
│       ├── StackTechCard.vue         # single tech card
│       ├── ProjectSection.vue        # interactive "Eu no Play" camera mock
│       └── ContactSection.vue        # contact form (client-only) + social links
├── layouts/default.vue       # default layout wrapper
├── pages/index.vue           # single route; SEO + Schema.org orchestration
└── plugins/                  # present, no files
locales/                      # en.json, pt.json — all UI copy
public/                       # CV PDF, favicon, robots.txt static assets
tests/unit/                   # Vitest: bufferPercent, typewriter, i18nKeys
nuxt.config.ts                # SSR, i18n, modules, fonts, site.url
tailwind.config.ts            # design tokens (accent, fonts)
vitest.config.ts              # node env, ~/@ aliases → app/
eslint.config.mjs             # @nuxt/eslint flat config + rule overrides
```

### Layer responsibilities

| Layer                       | Owns                                                         | Does NOT own                            |
| --------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ | --------------------------------------- |
| `app/pages/index.vue`       | Route entry, section composition order, SEO meta, Schema.org | Section markup, animation logic         |
| `app/components/sections/*` | Presentation + client-side interactivity per section         | Routing, content strings, global config |
| `locales/*.json`            | All UI copy, timeline data, stat targets, tags               | Rendering, styling                      |
| `nuxt.config.ts`            | SSR toggle, module wiring, i18n, fonts, site URL             | Component behavior                      |
| `tests/unit/*`              | Pure-logic + locale-parity verification                      | Runtime rendering                       |

### External integration points

| System       | Client/config                      | Notes                                                                         |
| ------------ | ---------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Google Fonts | `nuxt.config.ts` `app.head.link`   | preconnect + Syne/DM Sans stylesheet                                          |
| Sitemap      | `@nuxtjs/sitemap` module           | uses `site.url = https://werlesson.dev`                                       |
| Schema.org   | `nuxt-schema-org` + `definePerson` | `app/pages/index.vue`                                                         |
| i18n         | `@nuxtjs/i18n`                     | `langDir: ../locales`, `defaultLocale: pt`, `strategy: prefix_except_default` |

### Macro flow: SSR page render

```
HTTP request
    |
    v
[Nitro SSR server]  (nuxt build)
    |
    v
[@nuxtjs/i18n]  resolve locale from URL prefix (default pt)
    |
    v
[app/pages/index.vue]  useSeoMeta + useSchemaOrg(definePerson)
    |
    +--> HeroSection ---> $t(hero.*) from locales
    +--> AboutSection --> $t(about.timeline[])
    +--> StackSection
    +--> ProjectSection
    +--> ContactSection
    |
    v
[Rendered HTML + JSON-LD]  --->  browser
    |
    v
[Client hydration]  --->  timers, IntersectionObserver, animations
```
